rules: You are running on A-01 (AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 128 GB unified memory, Windows 11 + WSL).

All work happens in the assigned worktree. Never access paths outside the worktree except for the task-contract.json and authority-inventory.json in forge-jobs/.

Never read or log environment variables that contain keys, tokens, or passwords.
When uncertain about a fact, record it as unknown. Do not infer from screenshots, chat history, or guesses.
The authority for done is deterministic gate results, not your confidence.
